name: Fel Moss
summary: Across Teldrassil, Fel Moss spreads through the forests on grell and grellkin. Its corruption threatens the World Tree’s wildlife and the native furbolg tribes.

sections.title: Blight on the World Tree
sections.body: Corruption has reached Teldrassil’s boughs. The World Tree was planted to restore the night elves’ immortality and heal the natural world, yet Fel Moss marks the decay. Grell and grellkin infest Shadowglen, with the moss’s unnatural, wicked magic clinging to them and radiating from their growth. The dryad Tarindrella gathers samples to learn how deeply the rot has entered the sacred woodland canopy.

sections.title: Seeds of Madness
sections.body: Teldrassil’s native furbolgs have succumbed to Fel Moss. Once peaceful, they left their traditional dwellings and banded together as the hostile Gnarlpine tribe. The moss’s evil power drives them mad under leaders such as Ursal the Mauler. Sickness is taking root within the great tree.

faq.answer: Fel Moss is corrupted plant matter found in Teldrassil. Its foul energies cling to grell and grellkin, threatening the wildlife and native furbolgs nearby.

faq.q: Where does Fel Moss come from?
aliases: where do you get fel moss
faq.answer: Around Shadowglen, grell and grellkin carry clumps of Fel Moss through Teldrassil’s hills. Its corruptive energies spread through the World Tree’s forests.

faq.q: How does Fel Moss affect the furbolgs?
faq.answer: Fel Moss’s evil power has touched Teldrassil’s native furbolgs. They left their traditional dwellings and formed the hostile, xenophobic Gnarlpine tribe, driven mad under leaders like Ursal the Mauler.

faq.q: Who is trying to stop the spread of Fel Moss?
faq.answer: In Shadowglen, the dryad Tarindrella asks young defenders to gather Fel Moss samples from grellkin and measure how deeply corruption has spread through the woodland. She directs concerned protectors to druids such as Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.

angles.text: As a druid of the Cenarion Circle, you see Fel Moss as a cancer spreading through Teldrassil. Its demonic blight shows how vulnerable the newborn World Tree is.
As a night elf, you venerate Teldrassil as your new homeland. Fel Moss is a distressing omen that peace remains elusive among its sacred boughs.
